request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real skin, fabric, building and landscape texture, natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

A WAITER. A man of about thirty-five with short brown hair, in a white shirt, black vest and long black apron, stands in a restaurant between set tables and carries a round tray with two plates of food on one raised hand, a white cloth over his other forearm, smiling at the camera. He is plainly a waiter: not a cook, no chef hat, not in a kitchen. Exactly one person, whole upper body sharp and large in the middle of the photo; the workplace behind is plain to read but not crowded. No letters, words, numbers, logos, badges with writing or brand marks anywhere. Every visible hand has five natural fingers.
